rationale: Promising conceptually but not yet justified for implementation: critical evidence gaps remain around analytical sensitivity and per-sample yield for single‑vesicle droplet and low‑input proteomic/lipidomic readouts, validated spike‑in behavior that mimics endogenous EV capture/protection, capture specificity versus co‑isolates, and demonstration of reproducible inter‑lot fingerprinting (≥3 lots) and linkage to potency/stability. Substantial method development and pilot data addressing these points are required before proceeding.
